meta.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows (.md) Frontmatter
meta.description: Railroad diagram for the YAML frontmatter schema of gh-aw workflow markdown files

Workflow File.description: Complete structure of a gh-aw workflow .md file

Frontmatter.description: Top-level YAML fields (on: is required, all others optional)

Trigger Events.description: on: section — when the workflow should run

Trigger Block.description: Full YAML trigger configuration with optional enhancements

Fuzzy Schedule.description: Human-friendly schedule expressions (compiler scatters execution time)

Time Constraint.description: Optional time window for fuzzy schedules

Trigger Enhancements.description: Additional on: fields that modify trigger behavior

Skip-If Config.description: Shorthand string or object with query, max/min, scope

Permissions.description: GitHub token read permissions for the agent job

Tools Config.description: Tools available to the AI agent

MCP Server Defs.description: Custom MCP server configuration (one or more named servers)

Network Config.description: Control outbound network access via AWF firewall

Safe Outputs.description: Validated GitHub operations — agents run read-only, separate jobs execute requests

Global Safe-Output Options.description: Options that apply to all safe outputs

Issue & Discussion Outputs.description: Safe outputs for issues, discussions, and their lifecycle

Comment & Label Outputs.description: Safe outputs for comments, labels, reviewers, assignments

Pull Request Outputs.description: Safe outputs for PR creation, updates, reviews

Project & Release Outputs.description: Safe outputs for projects, releases, assets, code scanning

Orchestration Outputs.description: Safe outputs for workflow dispatch, workflow call, agent sessions

items.label: named tools with workflow, event_type, repository

Cross-Repo Fields.description: Fields available on most safe outputs for cross-repository operations

Observability Config.description: OTLP trace export to observability backends

Run & Misc Fields.description: Run configuration and miscellaneous top-level fields

Markdown Instructions.description: The agent prompt body — plain markdown after the closing ---

Comment Event Types.description: Activity types for issue_comment, pull_request_review_comment, and discussion_comment triggers

Cron Expression.description: Standard cron syntax with optional timezone

Pre-Activation Steps.description: Custom steps that run before the agent (outside firewall sandbox)

GitHub Tool Config.description: Configuration for the built-in GitHub tool

Message Templates.description: Custom notification message templates for safe outputs

Update Fields (status/title/body).description: Fields available on update-issue safe output

Custom Steps.description: Steps that run before the agent job in the workflow

Post Steps.description: Steps that run after the agent job completes

Custom Jobs.description: Additional workflow jobs alongside the agent job

Runtime Overrides.description: Override default runtime versions for language runtimes

items.label: node | python | go | uv | bun | deno | ruby | java | dotnet | elixir | haskell

Checkout Config.description: Extended checkout configuration for cross-repo workflows

Secrets Config.description: Secret values passed to workflow execution

MCP Scripts.description: Inline custom MCP tools using JavaScript or shell scripts

Service Containers.description: Service containers that run alongside the job (databases, caches)
